# Copilot instructions

Follow all rules in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root. It is the single source of truth for every agent.
Start every session with the checklist in `docs/COORDINATION.md`; your handoff file is
`coordination/handoff/copilot.md`.

Copilot's lane: `bridge/` (engine ↔ app connection), `cli/`, CMake build files, CI workflows, installers, and small bug fixes. Issues labeled `agent:copilot`.
